name: Digital Climate Strike Popup
project_description:
Digital Climate Strike Popup Module 
 Introduction 
 This module adds a "Digital Climate Strike" participation popup.

More info: https://digital.globalclimatestrike.net 

 Installation 
 Install via Drupal Administration or with the following composer commands

in project root folder: $ composer require drupal/dcs_popup and enable the module in your web folder: $ drush en dcs_popup 

 Configuration 
 To add 'Digital Climate Strike' popup you can go to: Configuration -> System -> Digital Climate Strike Popup Settings (admin/config/dcs_popup/settings) and choose the widget to use.
